/**
 * The DOM vocabulary.
 *
 * render.mjs writes these class names and attributes, dnd.mjs queries them, and
 * board.css styles them. Three tasks agree here instead of colliding in one file.
 */

export const CLASS = {
  board: 'board',
  list: 'board-list',
  listHeader: 'board-list__header',
  listTitle: 'board-list__title',
  listCount: 'board-list__count',
  listCards: 'board-list__cards',
  card: 'board-card',
  cardTitle: 'board-card__title',
  cardDone: 'board-card--done',
  dragging: 'is-dragging',
  dropTarget: 'is-drop-target',
  empty: 'board--empty',
}

export const ATTR = {
  list: 'data-list-id',
  card: 'data-card-id',
  index: 'data-index',
}

export const SELECTORS = {
  board: `.${CLASS.board}`,
  list: `.${CLASS.list}`,
  listCards: `.${CLASS.listCards}`,
  card: `.${CLASS.card}`,
}

# Trello-style board PWA - module contract New code is ESM with a `.mjs` extension. That keeps `package.json` on `"type": "commonjs"`, so the existing `src/lib/todos.js` and `src/components/todo-list/render.js` are untouched, while both the browser and `node --test` load the new modules natively. No build step, no dependencies. Run the app with `npm run serve`, then open . The server is rooted at the repo so `public/app.mjs` can import `../src/board/*.mjs`. ## Signatures `public/app.mjs` is committed with the contract and imports all of these. Match them exactly or the page will not boot. | Module | Exports | | --- | --- | | `src/board/store.mjs` | `createStore(board)` -> `{ getBoard(), subscribe(fn), addList(title), renameList(listId, title), addCard(listId, title), toggleCard(cardId), removeCard(cardId), moveCard(cardId, toListId, toIndex) }` | | `src/board/render.mjs` | `renderBoard(board)` -> HTML string | | `src/board/dnd.mjs` | `attachDragAndDrop(rootEl, { onMove })` -> `detach()`, plus pure `computeDrop(pointerY, cardBoxes)` -> insertion index | | `src/board/persist.mjs` | `saveBoard(storage, board)`, `loadBoard(storage)` -> board or `null`, `STORAGE_KEY` | | `src/pwa/register.mjs` | `registerServiceWorker(url, options?)` -> `Promise` | | `src/pwa/cache-strategy.mjs` | `APP_SHELL`, `cacheName(version)`, `isCacheable(url)`, `pickStrategy(url)` | `subscribe(fn)` returns an unsubscribe function and fires `fn(board)` after every mutation. `getBoard()` returns a deep copy - callers must not be able to mutate store state. ## What the contract provides - `src/board/schema.mjs` - `createCard`, `createList`, `createBoard`, `cloneBoard`, `assertBoard`, `nextId`, `BOARD_VERSION` - `src/board/dom-contract.mjs` - `CLASS`, `ATTR`, `SELECTORS`, `MOUNT_ID` - `src/board/fixtures.mjs` - `sampleBoard()`, `emptyBoard()`, `fakeStorage()` ## Markup shape The renderer emits, and the stylesheet and drag-and-drop both depend on: ```html

To do

``` Done cards carry `board-card--done` as well. Card titles must be HTML-escaped. ## Known limitation The service worker is registered as a module worker (`{ type: 'module' }`). Chrome, Edge and Safari 16.4+ support that; Firefox does not yet, so `registerServiceWorker` must fail soft and log rather than throw.

/**
 * The board store: columns, cards, and moves between columns.
 *
 * STUB - implemented by task `board-store`, which owns this file.
 * The signatures and behaviour below are the contract; do not change them.
 */

const { DEFAULT_COLUMNS } = require('./contract.js')

/**
 * Creates a board.
 *
 * The returned object is the whole public surface. Every getter returns copies,
 * so callers can never mutate the board by holding on to a result.
 *
 * - `snapshot()` -> BoardSnapshot. `cardsByColumn` has one key per column, in
 *   the same order as `columns`, each value an array (empty when no cards).
 * - `addCard(columnId, title)` -> Card. Appends to the bottom of that column,
 *   id from `nextCardId()`. Throws BoardError(ERR_UNKNOWN_COLUMN) if the column
 *   does not exist.
 * - `moveCard(cardId, toColumnId, toIndex)` -> Card. Removes the card from its
 *   current column and inserts it into `toColumnId` at `toIndex`, where index 0
 *   is the top. `toIndex` is optional and defaults to the bottom of the target
 *   column. An index past the end clamps to the bottom; a negative index clamps
 *   to the top. Moving inside the same column reorders it, computing the target
 *   position after the card has been lifted out. Throws
 *   BoardError(ERR_UNKNOWN_CARD) for an unknown card and
 *   BoardError(ERR_UNKNOWN_COLUMN) for an unknown target column.
 * - `removeCard(cardId)` -> boolean. True when a card was removed, false when
 *   the id was not on the board. Never throws.
 *
 * @param {import('./contract.js').Column[]} [columns] defaults to DEFAULT_COLUMNS
 * @returns {{
 *   snapshot: () => import('./contract.js').BoardSnapshot,
 *   addCard: (columnId: string, title: string) => import('./contract.js').Card,
 *   moveCard: (cardId: string, toColumnId: string, toIndex?: number) => import('./contract.js').Card,
 *   removeCard: (cardId: string) => boolean,
 * }}
 */
function createBoard(columns = DEFAULT_COLUMNS) {
  void columns
  throw new Error('not implemented: createBoard is owned by task board-store')
}

module.exports = { createBoard }

/**
 * Primitives for the board's plain-text format while a card is being dragged.
 *
 * `src/components/board/drag-render.js` (task dnd-render) must export
 * `renderBoardWithDrag(snapshot, drag)` built from exactly these pieces plus
 * the ones in `./format.js`. `drag` is a DragState and is optional; a missing,
 * null or idle drag renders byte-identical output to `renderBoard(snapshot)`.
 *
 * The frame does not change: one section per column in `snapshot.columns`
 * order, `columnHeader(column, cards.length)` on top, sections joined by
 * SECTION_SEPARATOR, no trailing newline. Header counts come straight from the
 * snapshot, because picking a card up does not move it yet.
 *
 * While dragging:
 *
 * - the dragged card keeps its place in its own column and is rendered with
 *   `draggingCardLine` instead of `cardLine`; every other card uses `cardLine`.
 * - when `drag.over` names this column, one DROP_INDICATOR_LINE is inserted
 *   immediately before the card at `drag.over.index`, counting ONLY the cards
 *   that are not the dragged card. The dragged card's own line keeps its
 *   position and is skipped while counting. An index at or past the number of
 *   those cards puts the indicator at the very bottom of the section.
 * - a column with no cards renders EMPTY_COLUMN_LINE as before, unless it is
 *   the drop target, in which case its body is the single DROP_INDICATOR_LINE.
 * - a section that has at least one card line never shows EMPTY_COLUMN_LINE.
 *
 * Dragging `card-2` from To Do, hovering To Do at index 0:
 *
 *     == To Do (2) ==
 *     > drop here
 *     - card-1 try session-share
 *     ~ card-2 split this app
 *
 *     == Doing (0) ==
 *     (empty)
 *
 * The same drag, hovering Doing with no index (the bottom of an empty column):
 *
 *     == To Do (2) ==
 *     - card-1 try session-share
 *     ~ card-2 split this app
 *
 *     == Doing (0) ==
 *     > drop here
 */

/** Marks the slot the dragged card would land in. */
const DROP_INDICATOR_LINE = '> drop here'

/** Prefix for the card currently held by the drag, in place of cardLine's '- '. */
const DRAGGING_CARD_PREFIX = '~ '

/**
 * @param {import('../../lib/board/contract.js').Card} card
 * @returns {string}
 */
function draggingCardLine(card) {
  return `${DRAGGING_CARD_PREFIX}${card.id} ${card.title}`
}

module.exports = {
  DROP_INDICATOR_LINE,
  DRAGGING_CARD_PREFIX,
  draggingCardLine,
}
